title: Halo Desk
description: A desktop productivity app for focused planning, clear priorities, and beautifully structured days.

sections.title: Navbar
sections.summary: Refined top navigation bar with custom animated Halo logo icon, navigation anchors, and early-access download actions.

sections.title: Hero & Desktop in Miniature
sections.summary: Left column editorial copy with feature selector chips (Tasks, Calendar, Focus Mode, Notes); Right column interactive desktop window simulating the live Halo Desk application with task toggles, quick task creation, weekday calendar navigation, focus timer with progress circle, and realistic sticky notes.

sections.title: The Calm System
sections.summary: Interactive card showcase breaking down the 4 pillars of mindful productivity (Spatial Day Structuring, Timebox Alignment, Low-Cognitive Friction, Local-First Privacy).

sections.title: Workflow Storyboard
sections.summary: Step-by-step visual progression demonstrating how a peaceful day unfolds from morning planning to afternoon flow and evening reflection.

sections.title: Feature Lab
sections.summary: Hands-on sandbox letting visitors test drive the four key application modules (Tasks, Calendar, Focus, Notes) with interactive controls.

sections.title: Curated Templates
sections.summary: One-click rhythm presets (Deep Focus Sprint, Balanced Product Flow, Executive Alignment) that instantly reconfigure the hero simulation.

sections.title: Meaningful Details
sections.summary: Tactile micro-features including keyboard shortcuts, sensory feedback toggles, and notification shields.

sections.title: Pricing & Early Access
sections.summary: Transparent pricing tier comparison with an accessible modal supporting email validation and desktop download.

customCodeBlocks.title: Halo Desk Scoped Styles
customCodeBlocks.description: Authored custom CSS variables, pseudo-elements, and keyframe rules that supplement native Webflow styles.

customCodeBlocks.title: Halo Desk Interactive Runtime Bridge
customCodeBlocks.description: Loads motion in page footer custom code with prefers-reduced-motion guard.
